LanguageData.LP_EttinLoneHead.label: lone head
LanguageData.LP_EttinLoneHead.description: The ettin has lost a head (the other head took the lethal head wound: the wounds and the loss count on the head that's gone); the remaining head must watch the road and keep watch alone: sight ×75%, taking turns at watch and two-headed discord stop working, mood -8. The remaining head eats and talks as usual.
